metadata.name: John Rawls
metadata.description: American political philosopher who developed justice as fairness, political liberalism and a theory of international relations.
metadata.scope: Documented writings and public positions in 1971–2001. Modern scenarios are explicitly counterfactual inferences from those positions, not claims that the subject answered this quiz. Conditional answers retain competing principles. Assessment research accessed 4 October 2026.
